subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a display-only `label` field across stable ID-keyed channel group-entry maps, and which channel entry types are in scope for the first contract?
rationale: The field name and cross-channel scope create a public configuration contract; source evidence shows no existing canonical metadata field, while the related WhatsApp proposal uses names for security-sensitive runtime matching rather than display.

options.title: Standardize `label` across group entries
options.body: Add one inert optional string field to the shared built-in group-entry contract and document that stable IDs remain the routing keys.

options.title: Limit the first change to selected channels
options.body: Add a display field only where maintainers confirm the ID-key readability problem, accepting a narrower and less uniform contract.

options.title: Keep metadata out of group entries
options.body: Decline a new config surface and direct users to external configuration inventory or documentation practices.

recommendation.title: Standardize `label` across group entries
recommendation.body: Add one inert optional string field to the shared built-in group-entry contract and document that stable IDs remain the routing keys.

likelyOwner.reason: Current and historical evidence place the shared channel configuration contract in this contributor's area.
